_note: Terror groups (Captain, 2026-10-20; docs/terror_groups.md): the Ashen Banner, the Valley Shura, the Saltline Syndicate, the Kestrel Cartel and the Highland Free Front join; Black Ridge shrinks to a regional militia. "side" is how a hostile is drawn and marked (militia orange, hostile red); "doctrine" its men fight by; "bombers" whether it sends suicide bombers and VBIEDs; "war_wants" the zone assets it fights for (WorldSites, the living war); "symbol" its fictional flag. The faction set before that (wave 6b call 4, Captain 2026-10-18, as proposed): Meridian employs, Vantage is the rival PMC, the US, UK and Canada are allied employers rippling together, Black Ridge the insurgents, the Eastern Concord Forces the one conventional army (RU/IR/CN kit by region), the Salvage Union neutral. Wants and fears are still placeholder lore.
_tiers: Wave 6a (2026-10-18): the five decided tiers (mission_brainstorm.md). pay_mult: what that faction pays at that tier (Proposed; docs/wave6_groundwork.md). Hostile offers no work.
_rules: Wave 6a, all Proposed (heat_*: wave 6d, a faction's anger: each of its men killed heat_kill, each of its sites taken out heat_site, cooling heat_cool_per_day; from heat_hunters its hunter teams come for the squad in any zone it holds, heat_named for named hunter squads, not built yet): ripple (a share of any rep change goes to the faction's allies, the opposite to its enemies), decay (rep drifts toward neutral by decay_per_day once decay_grace_days pass without a job; allied_grace_days for an Allied faction), and side lockout (taking a faction's contract locks you out of its enemies' work for lockout_days, counted again from the debrief).
_lawful: Wave 6 (item catalogue: contraband): a lawful faction thinks less of the company (-1) for each lot of contraband it sells at the base (Fixers.server_sell_at_base).
_quartermaster: Wave 6 (call #1): an allied employer's quartermaster sells the squad its kit cheaper at Trusted and its armour at Allied (Quartermaster); each tier's items and discount, the higher tier's list including the lower's. Proposed numbers.
_kits: Wave 6b (2026-10-18): what each enemy faction fields, by kit id (a faction's "kit"). body + one entry of guns by mix (a team, wave or garrison's i-th man gets mix[i % size]) + tail; roles casts a gun's carrier (Roles); variant is his camo (VoxelArt.VARIANTS). "insurgent" and "pmc" are Black Ridge's and Vantage's (CompoundLevel.hostile_loadout / rival_pmc_loadout, kept in code: Vantage's exo gear by difficulty lives there). Regional armies fight with what we have: the AK/PK/SVD family stands in until regional weapon art (Chinese, Iranian) lands. A kit's "nation" names its men (Names) over the faction's. Allied kits ("side": "friendly", wave 6e) dress AlliedTroops by employer; "mixes" holds other element types (the MG + AT weapons team).

radio: the road tax is due at the bridge by sundown. Nobody passes without paying.
the Shura burned another of our trucks. Double the guard on the pass.
the new crates came in. Same as before: say nothing on the net.
factions.name: Black Ridge Militia

factions.wants: Control the inland roads and tax every convoy.

factions.name: Vantage Group
factions.wants: Undercut Meridian's contracts and hold the ground it's paid to take.
factions.fears: A client who hires real competition instead of a militia.

radio: all units, maintain positions. Report every contact.
the border posts report quiet. Continue patrols.
headquarters wants the hills cleared by end of week.
factions.name: Eastern Concord Forces
factions.wants_text: strategic sites: HQs, airfields and the border

factions.fears: Foreign contractors reporting what it does there.

factions.fears: A contractor's mess on the evening news.

factions.name: UK Forces
factions.wants: Quiet recovery work and eyes on the coast.
factions.fears: Being dragged into somebody else's war.

factions.name: Canadian Forces

factions.fears: Losing an aid team in the hills.

radio: the brothers from the boats arrive tonight. Meet them at the shore.
the Engineer needs more wire and phones. Bring what you find.
nobody leaves their post. Nobody.
factions.name: Ashen Banner
factions._note: Terror groups (Captain, 2026-10-20; docs/terror_groups.md 2.1): a transnational jihadist network with foreign fighters. Fictional: its flag is an ash-grey field, a red arc over a white star, no writing.
factions.wants_text: oil, airfields and HQs: what the world notices
factions.wants: A borderless religious rule: every army and foreigner driven out, and seen to be.
factions.fears: Losing its foreign fighters' route in by sea.

radio: the elders say the foreigners came through the lower village. Watch the road.
the device on the north road is ready. Wait for the signal.
send the boys home before dark. Only fighters stay.
factions.name: Valley Shura
factions._note: Terror groups (docs/terror_groups.md 2.2): a local Islamist insurgency with kin in every village. Fictional flag: an olive pennant with a white mountain-and-river glyph, no writing.
factions.wants: Foreign troops and contractors out, its own law in the valleys, the militias off the villagers' backs.
factions.fears: The villages turning to someone else.

radio: the boat is late. Nobody touches the cargo until the Harbourmaster says.
the Kestrels were seen near the warehouse again. Shoot first.
the Bookkeeper wants the count by morning. All of it.
factions.name: Saltline Syndicate

factions.wants_text: harbours, crossings and the routes the goods move on

factions.fears: A war that closes the sea lanes.

radio: the lab needs another day. Keep everyone away from the farm.
the toll on the river road is doubled. Anyone who argues, bring them in.
the Patron says the Syndicate's boats don't land this week.
factions.name: Kestrel Cartel
factions._note: Cartels (docs/terror_groups.md 2.4): the inland drug trade, field to lab to the coast. A gold kestrel spray-painted on black.
factions.wants_text: fields, routes and crossings: field to lab to the coast

factions.fears: Its labs found and its fields burned.

radio: the Concord column passed the moor at dawn. Let it go, wait for the next.
the Commandant says no shooting at villagers. Ever.
the charge under the culvert is set. Stay off the road.

factions.wants_text: its highlands back and the Concord's posts
